scheme_name: PLI Scheme for White Goods Including Furniture Components
overview: The PLI Scheme for White Goods Including Furniture Components is a Production Linked Incentive scheme targeting manufacturers of components/sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights, offering 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.
eligibility: Manufacturers of components/sub-assemblies of Air Conditioners & LED Lights are eligible under the scheme.
benefits: The scheme offers 4–6% incentive on incremental sales to boost localization, reduce imports, and build a domestic supply chain.
financial_support: The scheme provides a 4–6% incentive on incremental sales as financial support to eligible manufacturers.
application_process: The application process details are not explicitly provided in the evidence.
implementing_agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
